messages:
joel: Poll time  not work stuff: pick a book + album combo for a rainy Sunday reading session. vote with emoji and drop 1-line reasons. \ntara: 7e2 Option A: Norse road-trip novel + lo-fi ambient album. 4d6 3b6
mina: 535 Option B: Neo-noir detective book + 70s jazz. perfect for slow-burn mood.
hiro: 7e0 Option C: Weird magical realism short stories + an old classical piano record. cozy and slightly uncanny.
omar: [31m Option D: Post-apocalyptic survival thriller + synthwave. ridiculous but cinematic.
joel: quick poll: 7e2 = A, 535 = B, 7e0 = C, [31m = D. I'll tally in 8 min.
jukebox-bot: dropped a tiny playlist for each: https://youtube.fake/playlistA (ambient), https://youtube.fake/playlistB (jazz), https://youtube.fake/playlistC (piano), https://youtube.fake/playlistD (synth)
tara: voting 7e2. ambient + open roads = perfect background, leaves space for the text.
mina: 535 B from me. sax lines with cigarette-lighting scenes in my head.
hiro: 7e0 C. piano makes the weird bits land right. also rec: short story "Map of Small Fires" for the mood.
omar: [31m D. can't resist synthy apocalypse vibes 923
joel: tally so far: A x2, B x1, C x1, D x1. leaning A. anyone want to champion a single track from their pick?
tara: from A: "Coastal Fog" by Low Drift 3b6 (loops without demanding attention).
mina: B rec: "Blue Midnight" - ten-minute sax outro is chef's kiss.
hiro: C rec: "Nocturne in Small Things" - simple piano, very eerie.
omar: D rec: "Motorway Night" - throwback synth bassline.
joel: ok going with A playlist on loop tonight for the reading hour. thanks! if anyone wants the playlist on shuffle DM me and I'll share. :headphones:
mina: also, shameless plug for tiny book swap at kitchen table 7pm. bring a wrapped one if you want.
tara: omg yes, I'll bring something weird.
jukebox-bot: reminder: office kitchen swap event at 19:00 today (auto-post).
